notes.title: Full version update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185352/ba3f326cd321a2a26e2810be1efabe574b9976cc.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Level 3 update, welcome to experience the winter street
[*] New gameplay expansion
[*] Complete story process
[*] New NPC dialogue and interaction
[*] New shops and forest scenery
[*] Guide system overhaul
[*] Art asset optimization
[*] Added controller support
[*] Added Steam achievements
[/list]
The duration of the complete game process has been doubled compared to the previous update.
Happy New Year!

notes.title: Updated on October 14th
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Gradually reduce water accumulation after entering the shop.
[*] Fire hydrants can block water splashes from vehicles.
[*] Optimize the dialogue UI display.
[*] Optimize directional key prompt display.
[*] Modify fire hydrant-related visuals.
[*] Fix the bug where the player is not getting wet by rain while affected by a fire hydrant leak.
[*] Fix the bug where a damaged umbrella can still block water from a fire hydrant leak.
[*] Fix the bug where holding an umbrella sideways prevents getting splashed by vehicles.
[*] Fix the bug where pressing a button while on a bench makes the player get wet.
[*] Fix the bug where there is no awning at the umbrella repair point.
[*] Fix the bug where the player can talk to NPCs outside the room from inside.
[*] Fix the bug where the umbrella inside the room doesn't visually change with durability.
[/list]
